"the emojis are not so good ... dont do the emoji its fine" -> emoji stickers removed, note card kept. This supersedes the earlier no-zoom-on-reactions note for these beats. V6: Tal - "we just use his cuts and how they flow as reference ... just look at the zoom ins". Measured frame by frame on Erez DdynV0UMrtr (two-camera bench surprise, 6.2-7.9s): WIDE -> a fast zoom-in over ~4 frames (0.13s) -> TIGHT hold with a slight continued push -> hard CUT to the other angle; time only moves forward; 0.3-1.0s shots, 2-3.5s holds on the key moments. This cut is built on that flow. V7: Tal - "ITS SO CHOPPY". Measured on V6: 10 frozen frames (one after each zoom ramp, cut points were off the 30fps grid; 583 frames in 19.92s) and a 25ms audio fade at each of 30 joins. Fix: every in/out on the frame grid, ramps exactly 4 frames, one continuous street-ambience bed (bedOnly) instead of 30 audio snippets. V8: Tal - "there is no speaking, so it is just the zoom in on emotional reactions ... and like when the guy is saying shhh, zoom in on that, then boom, give the flowers" + "more cute shots of her smiling ... like IMG 9263" -> added the shhh (2358 1.83-3.0, wide -> zoom -> hold) right before the handoff, and the 9263 laugh (0.5-1.6, wide -> zoom -> hold) after the slow-mo laugh. V9: Tal - "I dont know if its good to use the clip of her eating ... maybe zoom in on her face, then slow mo, then the flowers, make it so wholesome" -> the hand-at-mouth shots (2357 6.9-7.5, 9266 10.0-11.6: she was eating) are out; now: zoom onto her face on the side angle (2358 7.07-7.4), slow-mo as the bouquet reaches her (7.4-8.2), then front: she holds the flowers in both hands and looks at them (9266 11.4-12.8). V10: the shhh zoom re-aimed onto Tal (x .52 -> .36: he was cut at the left edge); her face zoom tightened to 3.0x on her face only (the snack in her fingers was in the 2.3x frame).
